title: Courtyard seed swap
brief:
Complete the following real project in the current, initially empty directory. Choose the deliverables, media, tools, structure and implementation that serve the intended user. Build usable artifacts and check your work. Deliver the project itself. Omit personally identifying credits, author signatures and model or toolchain identity labels. No network access or credentials are provided.

Design the information system for a spring seed swap hosted in a housing co-op courtyard. About 45 residents are expected, including children and first-time gardeners. The event has three tables for herbs, flowers, and vegetables, plus one shared station for labeling blank envelopes. Hosts open the swap with basil, calendula, and snap pea packets, and attendees can bring their own garden seeds. Create coordinated materials that guide visitors through browsing, labeling, and exchanging packets. Supplies include letter-size paper, markers, masking tape, and plain envelopes. Start from an empty directory and choose the artifacts, tools, and file layout. Make the designs practical to reproduce with a home printer.

Add the variety and harvest year</text><text x="83" y="276" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >if you know them. A host can help you write.</text><path d="M116 328 H495 V466 H116Z" stroke="#355b43" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M116 328 l20 16 h339 l20 -16" stroke="#355b43" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="142" y="373" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#355b43" letter-spacing="1.4">EXAMPLE PACKET</text><text x="141" y="427" font-family="Georgia" font-size="39" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >Snap pea</text><circle cx="54" cy="526" r="15" fill="white" stroke="#355b43" stroke-width="1.5"/><text x="54" y="531" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#355b43" text-anchor="middle">2</text><text x="83" y="533" font-family="Georgia" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >Fill it and fold it shut.</text><text x="83" y="560" font-family="Arial" font-size="17" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Use one kind of seed per envelope. files.body: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="8.5in" height="11in" viewBox="0 0 612 792"><text x="38" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#355b43" letter-spacing="1.4">COURTYARD SEED SWAP</text><text x="574" y="48" font-family="Arial" font-size="11" font-weight="bold" fill="#586159" text-anchor="end" letter-spacing="1">HOST COPY</text><path d="M38 62 L574 62" stroke="#202d27" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M38 740 L574 740" stroke="#202d27" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="38" y="761" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" font-weight="bold" fill="#355b43" >Print single-sided   /   US Letter   /   Actual size (100%)</text><text x="38" y="132" font-family="Georgia" font-size="50" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >Set up the swap</text><text x="39" y="167" font-family="Arial" font-size="18" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >One entrance sign, three seed tables, one envelope station.</text><path d="M38 204 L574 204" stroke="#202d27" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="38" y="233" font-family="Georgia" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >Before residents arrive</text><text x="38" y="259" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Tape the welcome sheet at the courtyard entrance. Face each</text><text x="38" y="280" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >table sign toward arriving visitors, where children can see it.</text><text x="38" y="301" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Set basil under Herbs, calendula under Flowers, and snap pea</text><text x="38" y="322" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >under Vegetables. Write the plant name on every starter packet.</text><path d="M38 357 L574 357" stroke="#202d27" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="38" y="386" font-family="Georgia" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >Prepare the shared station</text><text x="38" y="412" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Post the envelope sign above a clear writing surface. Set out</text><text x="38" y="433" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >blank envelopes, markers, and short strips of masking tape.</text><text x="38" y="454" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Leave room for two neighbors to write side by side. Keep the</text><text x="38" y="475" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >path between the station and the seed tables open.</text><path d="M38 513 L574 513" stroke="#202d27" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="38" y="542" font-family="Georgia" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >Open the swap</text><text x="38" y="568" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >“Welcome! Take one packet to start, even if you didn’t bring</text><text x="38" y="589" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >seeds. If you brought some to share, we’ll help you label them.”</text><text x="38" y="610" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Invite children to match the plant names or carry a closed packet.</text><path d="M38 646 L574 646" stroke="#202d27" stroke-width="1" fill="none" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/><text x="38" y="675" font-family="Georgia" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="#202d27" >During the swap</text><text x="38" y="701" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Refill envelopes and spread packets so names stay visible.</text><text x="38" y="722" font-family="Arial" font-size="16.5" font-weight="normal" fill="#202d27" >Keep unidentified seeds with their owner until identified.</text></svg>
